g.title:
3. Hybrid Connectivity & Perimeter Ingress [Network Backbone Tier] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: The dedicated inter-facility backbone encompassing the 1 Gbps Huawei Cloud Direct Connect circuit, backup IPsec VPN tunnels, low-latency (<2ms) DCI dark fiber rings, and perimeter Fortinet Next-Gen Firewalls (NGFW).
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Forms the mission-critical transport highway uniting Huawei Cloud with on-premise primary and disaster recovery data centers. Enforces zero-trust boundary segmentation, cryptographic encapsulation, and sub-millisecond data replication.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Huawei Cloud CCE Cluster via Direct Connect MPLS (Port 443), Primary DC Core Switches via 10 GbE SFP+ Cross-Connects, Secondary DR DC via DCI Dark Fiber Ring • OUTBOUND: Core Banking Middleware Bus (mTLS Port 443), Oracle Active Data Guard Standby (Port 1521), Databricks Delta Lake Bronze Stream (Port 9092) • FAILOVER: Sub-second BGP routing failover from Direct Connect 1 Gbps to redundant IPsec VPN tunnels; protected dual-routed metro dark fiber rings. • SECURITY: Hardware IPsec AES-256-GCM encryption, Fortinet deep packet inspection (DPI), Forcepoint SWG egress proxy, and strict network segmentation (DMZ). (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)
g.text: 3. HYBRID CONNECTIVITY & PERIMETER INGRESS
NETWORK

g.title:
Huawei Cloud Direct Connect (Primary 1 Gbps) [Section 3: Hybrid Connectivity] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: Dedicated private Layer-2/Layer-3 leased circuit terminating in Equinix/MainOne Primary DC with redundant BGP peering and jumbo frame support.
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Forms the central private network highway connecting the Huawei Cloud digital banking platform to on-premise Finacle Core Banking and streaming Databricks CDC pipelines.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Huawei Cloud Hybrid Gateway & CCE Cluster • OUTBOUND: Primary DC Core Banking Middleware Bus (mTLS Port 443), Databricks Delta Lake Bronze Stream (Port 9092) • FAILOVER: Automated sub-second BGP failover to dual IPsec VPN backup tunnels over public internet backhauls. • SECURITY: Dedicated physical fiber isolated from the public internet, mutual TLS (mTLS) application encryption, and 802.1Q VLAN encapsulation. (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)
g.text: Huawei Cloud Direct Connect (Primary 1 Gbps)
Dedicated Private Layer-2/Layer-3 Circuit:
• Dedicated sub-10ms leased fiber circuit terminating in Equinix/MainOne Primary DC
• Redundant BGP peering with jumbo frame support for high-throughput database CDC
• Dual physical cross-connects via MainOne & Priority Communications
• Carries Core Banking API traffic, Kafka streams, and Databricks CDC pipelines
DIRECT CONNECT 1Gbps
Dual IPsec VPN Tunnels (Automated Backup)
Encrypted Fallback Transport over Public Internet:
• AES-256 GCM encrypted tunnel running over diverse telco internet backhauls
• BGP Route health monitoring with automated sub-second failover on Direct Connect failure
• Terminated on Fortinet FortiGate enterprise cluster in Primary DC
IPSEC VPN BACKUP

g.title:
Inter-DC Dark Fiber Ring (DCI Interconnect) [Section 3: Hybrid Connectivity] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: High-bandwidth, ultra-low latency (<2ms round-trip) metro dark fiber ring connecting the Primary Data Center (Lekki) to the Secondary DR Data Center (Ikeja).
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Transports synchronous block-level database redo logs for Oracle Active Data Guard with guaranteed zero data loss (RPO = 0), alongside Dell Data Domain backup replication.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Primary DC Oracle 19c RAC Nodes and Dell Data Domain • OUTBOUND: Secondary DR DC Oracle Standby (Port 1521) and DR Data Domain (Port 2051) • FAILOVER: Dual-routed physical fiber paths provided by Broadbased Communications and 21st Century Technologies with automated optical switching. • SECURITY: Private dedicated dark fiber cores with hardware-level optical wiretap protection. (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)
g.text: Inter-DC Dark Fiber Ring (DCI Interconnect)
Ultra-Low Latency Backbone between Primary & DR Data Centers:
• Dual-routed protected fiber paths by Broadbased Communications & 21st Century
• Sub-2ms round-trip latency enabling zero-loss synchronous Oracle Active Data Guard
• Carries Dell Data Domain DD Boost backup replication and storage mirroring
DCI DARK FIBER (<2ms)
Perimeter Ingress & Next-Gen Firewalls (NGFW)
Enterprise Perimeter Defense Tier:
• Active-Active Fortinet FortiGate enterprise cluster with deep packet inspection
• Ingress demilitarized zone (DMZ) isolating branch SD-WAN and external partner VPNs
• Forcepoint Secure Web Gateway (SWG) filtering all outbound internet access
• Microsoft Entra ID SAML authentication proxy & Delinea PAM privileged bastion
FORTIGATE NGFW
FORCEPOINT SWG
